Apartments

Five separate, modern apartments; apartment no. 5 has a large common room with a fireplace. In July and August apartments 1–4 are let individually; outside the season only the whole property.

Individual apartments in summer season only

Apartments 1–4 are let individually only from 28 June to 29 August 2027, minimum stay 3 nights. Please choose dates within this period in the booking form – the apartments are not available at other times.

Outside the season (September – June) we only let the whole property to one group. Rent the whole property →

Apartments 1–4 equipment

  • Kitchenette with crockery, microwave, two-ring hob, kettle and fridge – self-catering
  • TV, Wi-Fi, hairdryer
  • Towel for every guest, bed linen
  • Entry by PIN code or key card
  • Infrared panel heating with automatic control
  • Iron, ironing board and clothes airer in every apartment
  • Cot on request, add it directly when booking

Accessibility

A ramp leads into the complex, to the pool and onto the terrace, suitable for wheelchairs and pushchairs. Apartment no. 1 is partly step-free, reached via a slope. The other apartments are up steps.

Summer season 28 June – 29 August 2027

In July and August the property is not let as a whole. You can book individual apartments 1–4 online. Minimum stay 3 nights. The booking form below shows current prices and available apartments.
